name: Eraser
tagline: AI co-pilot for technical design — diagrams and docs as code.
description: Eraser is a collaborative whiteboard and docs tool for engineering teams where diagrams are written as code. Its AI generates flowcharts, ERDs, sequence, and cloud-architecture diagrams from a prompt or a pasted code snippet, then lets you refine them in diagram-as-code syntax. It syncs with GitHub and embeds into Notion and Confluence.
insight: Its 2023 sidecar DiagramGPT, which turns code or prose into diagrams, grew to drive roughly 30% of Eraser's signups.

modelSupport.notes: DiagramGPT generates diagrams from code or natural language; built on GPT-4.

edge: Generates diagrams as editable code, not static images, so engineers can version, diff, and refine architecture diagrams like source.
pros: Diagrams from code or natural language
Free plan plus VS Code extension
cons: Free plan caps files and AI credits
Aimed at technical diagrams, not general design
AI credits metered on every plan

references.title: How an AI sidecar product drove 30% of sign-ups: Eraser's DiagramGPT
